name: BeatBall
summary:
# 🥊BEATBALL🥊

**Jab**, **Hook**, **Uppercut**, and **Slam** your way through the music in our colorful fitness **RHYTHM** game made exclusively for the Meta Quest. Survive the musical onslaught tied to every kick and snare of the beat by punching beatballs towards their targets. Experience satisfying combat in levels inspired by both existing and BeatBall original songs.
